objective: reduce ambiguous Phase 2 work without deleting valid roadmap scope

decisions.reason: Master autonomy roadmap remains the product-level source of direction and completion criteria.
The 42-day campaign tracker remains active through the release window.
Lever platform evidence, supervised pilot, and future promotion remain broader than Phase A collection.
Days 8-14 need a bounded queue dedicated to 30 qualifying synthetic Lever dry runs under frozen rules.
The retained-evidence pull request is merged historical evidence, not an open collection branch or promotion gate.
The divergent draft was already closed and explicitly superseded by the merged replacement.
Each pull request is the immutable implementation and verification record for one Phase 1 control domain.
This merged correction establishes the hardened 0/30 Lever baseline and remains load-bearing for Phase 2.

closure_rationale: No currently open issue was both obsolete and safely separable from remaining work. The useful surgery was to split #161 and clarify the roles of #13, #154, and #86 rather than manufacture closure statistics.
